title: Workspace link
responsibility: Opens an address within the selected project while preserving normal browser behavior for modified clicks.

inputs.name: WorkspaceLink.workspace
inputs.description: The Workspace whose navigate(to) opens the address after a primary-button click with no meta, control, shift or alt key held and whose default was not already prevented. navigate does nothing without a connected bridge and never rejects, since a failure of the latest navigation is stored in the workspace's error field.

inputs.name: WorkspaceLink.to
inputs.description: A workspace address, as workspace.path or workspace.link builds it, starting with /harness or /projects/{id}/harness; an address that does not parse makes navigate record an error in the workspace's error field. The rendered href is the hosting app's base from $app/paths followed by this value, and navigate receives it unchanged.

inputs.name: WorkspaceLink.class
inputs.description: The class attribute of the rendered hx-a element, as a space-separated list of class names. It defaults to an empty string, which adds no classes.

inputs.name: WorkspaceLink.label
inputs.description: The accessible name passed as aria-label, meant for a link whose visible children do not say what it does. It is undefined when omitted.

inputs.name: WorkspaceLink.title
inputs.description: The value passed as the title attribute, which the browser shows as a tooltip on hover; it is meant as short hover text for an icon-only link. It is undefined when omitted.

inputs.name: WorkspaceLink.children
inputs.description: The visible text or icon of the link, rendered directly inside the hx-a element with no wrapper added by this component.

outputs.name: WorkspaceLink
outputs.description: An hx-a element whose href is the app base plus to, carrying the class, title and aria-label values it was given. A plain primary-button click with no modifier key is prevented and passed to workspace.navigate; a modified, non-primary, or already prevented click keeps the browser's usual behavior.
